reference.question: A written test score of 80 points has a weight of 40%, and an interview score of 90 points has a weight of 60%. What is the overall score? (Unit: points; write only the number.)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Add the weighted contributions

The overall score is $80\times40\%+90\times60\%=32+54=86$.
